Pl. 1: 423. 1753.|volume=6|p=45|series=[[Flora of China (series)|Flora of China]]}} ==Ecology== The [[ant]]s tend to pollinate ''Arenaria serpyllifolia''.{{cite journal|last1=Mayer|first1=Ellen|title=Die Auswirkung von Ameisen auf den Reproduktionserfolg des Quendelblättrigen Sandkrautes (Arenaria serpyllifolia, Caryophyllaceae)|journal=Botanische Jahrbücher|volume=124|issue=1|year=2002|pp=31-47|doi=10.1127/0006-8152/2002/0124-0031}} ==Uses== The extract of the plant is used traditionally to treat kidney and bladder related problems, as well as cough and [[dysentery]].{{cite journal|title=Anti-tussive Activity of Arenaria serpyllifolia L. and Fragaria nubicola (Hook. f) L. on Sulfurdioxide Induced Cough in Rats|last1=Roshan|first1=Rifat|last2=Gilani|first2=Syed Muhammad Umer|last3=Ahmed|first3=Salman|last4=Hasan|first4=Muhammad Mohtasheemul|journal=RADS Journal of Pharmacy and Allied Health Sciences|volume=3|number=3|year=2025|doi=10.37962/jphs.v3i3.143}} ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Taxonbar|from=Q937450|knsl=yes}} [[Category:Arenaria (plant)|serpyllifolia]] [[Category:Flora of Africa]] [[Category:Flora of Europe]] [[Category:Flora of temperate Asia]] [[Category:Flora of tropical Asia]] [[Category:Plants described in 1753]] [[Category:Botanical taxa named by Carl Linnaeus]] [[Category:Flora of Korea]] {{Caryophyllaceae-stub}}
